
AFFECT /qml/common/SceneSelectionHandler.qml
    IMPORT net.asivery.CommandExecutor 1.0

    TRAVERSE Item > SelectionContextualMenu#tools
        LOCATE AFTER ArkControls.ContextualMenu.Button#convertToText
        INSERT {
        ArkControls.ContextualMenu.Button {
            id: saverSend
            focusPolicy: Qt.NoFocus
            visible: controller && saverSend.likelyHasStroke()
            type: tools.type
            iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/checkmark_circle"

            property bool armed: false

            property string pendingOperation: ""
            property var pendingContext: ({})
            property string commandOutput: ""
            property bool commandTimedOut: false

            property string timeZone: "UTC"

            property string queuedOperation: ""
            property var queuedArguments: []
            property var queuedContext: ({})

            // Defer chained requests until runningChanged returns.
            Timer {
                id: saverQueuedCommand
                interval: 50
                repeat: false
                onTriggered: {
                    var operation = saverSend.queuedOperation;
                    var args = saverSend.queuedArguments;
                    var context = saverSend.queuedContext;
                    saverSend.queuedOperation = "";
                    saverSend.queuedArguments = [];
                    saverSend.queuedContext = {};
                    saverSend.runCommand(operation, args, context);
                }
            }

            Timer {
                id: saverRequestWatchdog
                interval: 20000
                repeat: false
                onTriggered: {
                    if (saverCommand.running) {
                        saverSend.commandTimedOut = true;
                        saverCommand.terminateCommand(100);
                        saverToast.show("Saver took too long to respond. Check WiFi", false);
                    }
                }
            }

            // The recognizer can fail without ever publishing a job, so the
            // signals below are a fast path and this poll is what ends the wait.
            Timer {
                id: saverJobPoll
                interval: 400
                repeat: true
                running: saverSend.armed

                property int ticks: 0
                readonly property int startGrace: 13   // ~5s to publish a job
                readonly property int limit: 50        // ~20s overall

                onRunningChanged: {
                    if (running) {
                        saverJobPoll.ticks = 0;
                    }
                }

                onTriggered: {
                    saverJobPoll.ticks += 1;
                    saverSend.handleJobUpdate();
                }
            }

            AsyncCommandExecutor {
                id: saverCommand
                command: "/home/root/xovi/exthome/appload/com.saverapp.remarkable/backend/entry"
                environment: ({ "HOME": "/home/root" })

                onStdOutAvailable: function (output) {
                    saverSend.commandOutput += output;
                }

                onStdErrAvailable: function (errors) {
                    console.log("SAVER: capture backend stderr:", errors);
                }

                onRunningChanged: {
                    if (!running && saverSend.pendingOperation.length > 0) {
                        saverSend.finishCommand();
                    }
                }
            }

            onClicked: {
                if (!controller) {
                    return;
                }
                saverSend.armed = true;
                saverToast.show("Converting handwriting...", true);
                Recognizer.startSelectionToolJob(
                    controller.cloneSelectedItems(controller.currentLayer, saverSend.cloneScale()),
                    Settings.handwritingConversionLanguage);
            }

            function likelyHasStroke() {
                if (!controller) {
                    return false;
                }
                if (typeof controller.selectionContainsStroke !== "undefined") {
                    return controller.selectionContainsStroke;
                }
                return true;
            }

            function cloneScale() {
                if (typeof sceneView !== "undefined" && sceneView && sceneView.defaultScale > 0) {
                    return sceneView.defaultScale;
                }
                return 1;
            }

            Connections {
                target: Recognizer.selectionToolJob
                enabled: saverSend.armed

                function onStatusChanged() {
                    saverSend.handleJobUpdate();
                }

                function onErrorChanged() {
                    saverSend.handleJobUpdate();
                }

                function onFinished() {
                    saverSend.handleJobUpdate();
                }
            }

            Connections {
                target: Recognizer
                enabled: saverSend.armed

                function onSelectionToolJobChanged() {
                    saverSend.handleJobUpdate();
                }
            }

            function handleJobUpdate() {
                if (!saverSend.armed) {
                    return;
                }

                var job = Recognizer.selectionToolJob;
                if (!job) {
                    if (saverJobPoll.ticks >= saverJobPoll.startGrace) {
                        saverSend.finishConversion();
                        saverToast.show("Conversion did not start. Check WiFi", false);
                    }
                    return;
                }

                if (job.error !== undefined
                    && job.error !== RecognitionJob.ConvertError.NoError) {
                    saverSend.finishConversion();
                    saverToast.show(saverSend.errorMessage(job.error), false);
                    return;
                }
                if (job.status === RecognitionJob.Status.Done) {
                    saverSend.finishConversion();
                    saverSend.beginFlow(job.plainText);
                    return;
                }
                if (job.status !== RecognitionJob.Status.Processing) {
                    saverSend.finishConversion();
                    saverToast.show(saverSend.errorMessage(job.error), false);
                    return;
                }
                if (saverJobPoll.ticks >= saverJobPoll.limit) {
                    saverSend.finishConversion();
                    saverToast.show("Handwriting conversion timed out. Check WiFi", false);
                }
            }

            function finishConversion() {
                saverSend.armed = false;
            }

            function errorMessage(code) {
                if (code === RecognitionJob.ConvertError.AuthenticationError) {
                    return "Sign in to reMarkable to convert handwriting";
                }
                if (code === RecognitionJob.ConvertError.NetworkError) {
                    return "No connection. Conversion needs WiFi";
                }
                if (code === RecognitionJob.ConvertError.ServerError) {
                    return "Conversion failed. Check WiFi, then try again";
                }
                if (code === RecognitionJob.ConvertError.NoText
                    || code === RecognitionJob.ConvertError.NoTasks) {
                    return "No handwriting recognised";
                }
                return "Handwriting conversion failed";
            }

            function beginFlow(text) {
                var trimmed = (text || "").trim();
                if (trimmed.length === 0) {
                    saverToast.show("No handwriting recognised", false);
                    return;
                }

                saverSend.runCommand("config", ["--capture-config"], { text: trimmed });
            }

            function runCommand(operation, args, context) {
                if (saverCommand.running) {
                    saverToast.show("Saver is already handling a request", false);
                    return;
                }
                saverSend.pendingOperation = operation;
                saverSend.pendingContext = context || {};
                saverSend.commandOutput = "";
                saverSend.commandTimedOut = false;
                saverCommand.arguments = args;
                if (!saverCommand.startCommand()) {
                    saverSend.pendingOperation = "";
                    saverToast.show("Could not start Saver", false);
                    return;
                }
                saverRequestWatchdog.restart();
            }

            function finishCommand() {
                saverRequestWatchdog.stop();
                var operation = saverSend.pendingOperation;
                var context = saverSend.pendingContext;
                var output = saverSend.commandOutput;
                var timedOut = saverSend.commandTimedOut;
                saverSend.pendingOperation = "";
                saverSend.pendingContext = {};
                saverSend.commandOutput = "";
                saverSend.commandTimedOut = false;

                if (timedOut) {
                    return;
                }

                var response;
                try {
                    response = JSON.parse(output);
                } catch (err) {
                    console.log("SAVER: invalid capture backend response:", output);
                    response = { error: "Invalid response from Saver" };
                }
                if (!response || typeof response !== "object") {
                    response = { error: "Invalid response from Saver" };
                }
                saverSend.handleCommandResult(operation, response, context);
            }

            function handleCommandResult(operation, response, context) {
                if (operation === "config") {
                    if (response.error) {
                        console.log("SAVER: capture config ->", response.error);
                        saverToast.show("Could not read Saver settings", false);
                        return;
                    }
                    if (!response.hasToken) {
                        saverToast.show("Link the tablet in the Saver app first", false);
                        console.log("SAVER: no device token available to capture backend");
                        return;
                    }
                    saverSend.timeZone = response.timeZone || "UTC";
                    var defaultSpaceId = response.notebookDefaultSpaceId || "";
                    var defaultListId = defaultSpaceId.length > 0
                        ? (response.notebookDefaultListId || "") : "";
                    if (response.confirmNotebookTodos === false) {
                        saverToast.show("Saving " + saverToast.shorten(context.text) + "...", true);
                        saverSend.fetchPickerOptions(context.text, defaultSpaceId, defaultListId,
                                                     true);
                        return;
                    }
                    saverToast.show("Loading your spaces...", true);
                    saverSend.fetchPickerOptions(context.text, defaultSpaceId, defaultListId,
                                                 false);
                    return;
                }

                if (operation === "list") {
                    if (response.error) {
                        console.log("SAVER: listPickerOptions ->", response.error);
                        saverToast.show("Could not reach Saver. Check WiFi", false);
                        return;
                    }
                    if (context.auto) {
                        var target = saverSend.resolveTarget(response.spaces || [],
                                                             response.activeSpaceId || "",
                                                             context.defaultSpaceId,
                                                             context.defaultListId);
                        if (!target.spaceId) {
                            saverToast.show("No Saver space to save to", false);
                            return;
                        }
                        saverSend.postTodo(context.text, target.spaceId, target.listId, null);
                        return;
                    }
                    saverToast.show("", false);
                    saverConfirm.openFor(context.text, response.spaces || [],
                                         response.activeSpaceId || "",
                                         context.defaultSpaceId, context.defaultListId,
                                         saverSend.timeZone);
                    return;
                }

                if (operation === "create") {
                    console.log("SAVER: createTodoFromNotebook ->", JSON.stringify(response));
                    if (response.error) {
                        saverToast.show(response.error, false);
                        return;
                    }
                    if (!context.reminder) {
                        saverToast.show("Added to Saver: " + saverToast.shorten(context.text), false);
                        return;
                    }
                    if (!response.id || context.spaceId.length === 0) {
                        console.log("SAVER: cannot attach a reminder without an id and a space");
                        saverToast.show("Added to Saver, but the reminder could not be set", false);
                        return;
                    }
                    saverToast.show("Setting the reminder...", true);
                    saverSend.queueCommand("remind",
                                           ["--capture-api", JSON.stringify({
                                               op: "updateTodo",
                                               spaceId: context.spaceId,
                                               todoId: response.id,
                                               text: context.text,
                                               reminder: context.reminder,
                                               removeReminder: false,
                                           })],
                                           { text: context.text });
                    return;
                }

                if (operation === "remind") {
                    console.log("SAVER: updateTodo (reminder) ->", JSON.stringify(response));
                    if (response.error) {
                        saverToast.show("Added to Saver, but the reminder could not be set", false);
                    } else {
                        saverToast.show("Added with a reminder: "
                                        + saverToast.shorten(context.text), false);
                    }
                }
            }

            function fetchPickerOptions(text, defaultSpaceId, defaultListId, auto) {
                saverSend.runCommand("list",
                                     ["--capture-api", JSON.stringify({ op: "listPickerOptions" })],
                                     {
                                         text: text,
                                         defaultSpaceId: defaultSpaceId,
                                         defaultListId: defaultListId,
                                         auto: auto === true,
                                     });
            }

            // A stored default is only a preference: the space or list can be
            // deleted from the web app after it was picked.
            function resolveTarget(spaces, activeSpaceId, defaultSpaceId, defaultListId) {
                var space = null;
                for (var i = 0; i < spaces.length; i++) {
                    if (spaces[i].id === defaultSpaceId) {
                        space = spaces[i];
                        break;
                    }
                }
                for (var j = 0; !space && j < spaces.length; j++) {
                    if (spaces[j].id === activeSpaceId) {
                        space = spaces[j];
                    }
                }
                if (!space) {
                    space = spaces.length > 0 ? spaces[0] : null;
                }
                if (!space) {
                    return { spaceId: "", spaceName: "No space available",
                             listId: "", listName: "No list" };
                }

                var listId = "";
                var listName = "No list";
                if (space.id === defaultSpaceId && defaultListId.length > 0) {
                    var lists = space.lists || [];
                    for (var k = 0; k < lists.length; k++) {
                        if (lists[k].id === defaultListId) {
                            listId = lists[k].id;
                            listName = lists[k].title;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
                return { spaceId: space.id, spaceName: space.name,
                         listId: listId, listName: listName };
            }

            function queueCommand(operation, args, context) {
                saverSend.queuedOperation = operation;
                saverSend.queuedArguments = args;
                saverSend.queuedContext = context || {};
                saverQueuedCommand.restart();
            }

            function postTodo(text, spaceId, parentId, reminder) {
                var body = { op: "createTodoFromNotebook", text: text };
                if (spaceId.length > 0) {
                    body.spaceId = spaceId;
                }
                if (parentId.length > 0) {
                    body.parentId = parentId;
                }

                saverSend.runCommand("create", ["--capture-api", JSON.stringify(body)],
                                     { text: text, spaceId: spaceId,
                                       reminder: reminder || null });
            }
        }
        }
    END TRAVERSE

    TRAVERSE Item
        LOCATE AFTER SelectionContextualMenu#tools
        INSERT {
        Rectangle {
            id: saverToast

            property string message: ""

            z: 200
            visible: saverToast.message.length > 0
            anchors.top: parent.top
            anchors.topMargin: 40
            anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
            width: Math.min(parent.width - 80, saverToastLabel.implicitWidth + 56)
            height: saverToastLabel.implicitHeight + 36
            color: "white"
            border.color: "black"
            border.width: 3
            radius: 8
            antialiasing: false

            Text {
                id: saverToastLabel
                anchors.centerIn: parent
                width: Math.min(implicitWidth, saverToast.parent.width - 136)
                text: saverToast.message
                font.pixelSize: 30
                color: "black"
                elide: Text.ElideRight
                horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
            }

            Timer {
                id: saverToastTimer
                interval: 4000
                repeat: false
                onTriggered: saverToast.message = ""
            }

            // Anchor to the window root, not to the selection handler's item,
            // which can be hidden as soon as a conversion ends.
            Component.onCompleted: {
                var top = saverToast.parent;
                while (top && top.parent) {
                    top = top.parent;
                }
                if (top && top !== saverToast.parent) {
                    saverToast.parent = top;
                }
            }

            function show(text, sticky) {
                saverToast.message = text;
                saverToastTimer.stop();
                if (text.length > 0 && !sticky) {
                    saverToastTimer.restart();
                }
            }

            function shorten(text) {
                var quote = String.fromCharCode(34);
                var flat = text.replace("\n", " ").trim();
                if (flat.length > 38) {
                    flat = flat.substring(0, 38) + "...";
                }
                return quote + flat + quote;
            }
        }

        Rectangle {
            id: saverConfirm

            property string text: ""
            property var spaces: []
            property string spaceId: ""
            property string spaceName: ""
            property string listId: ""
            property string listName: "No list"
            property string picking: ""

            property bool reminderEnabled: false
            property var reminderAt: new Date()
            property var reminderWeekdays: []
            property bool reminderPlaysSound: true
            property bool reminderIsImportant: false
            property string timeZone: "UTC"

            property string repeatMode: "none"
            property bool reminderNudging: false
            property var calendarMonth: new Date()

            readonly property int pageHeight: {
                if (saverConfirm.picking === "date") return 780;
                if (saverConfirm.picking === "reminder") {
                    if (!saverConfirm.reminderEnabled) return 280;
                    var height = 700;
                    if (saverConfirm.reminderNudging) height += 88;
                    if (saverConfirm.repeatMode === "weekly"
                        || saverConfirm.repeatMode === "custom") height += 76;
                    return height;
                }
                if (saverConfirm.picking.length > 0) return 760;
                return 600;
            }

            z: 300
            visible: false
            anchors.centerIn: parent
            width: Math.min(parent.width - 160, 820)
            height: Math.min(parent.height - 120, saverConfirm.pageHeight)
            color: "white"
            border.color: "black"
            border.width: 3
            radius: 10
            antialiasing: false

            MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent }

            function findSpace(id) {
                for (var i = 0; i < saverConfirm.spaces.length; i++) {
                    if (saverConfirm.spaces[i].id === id) {
                        return saverConfirm.spaces[i];
                    }
                }
                return null;
            }

            function currentLists() {
                var space = saverConfirm.findSpace(saverConfirm.spaceId);
                return (space && space.lists) ? space.lists : [];
            }

            function defaultReminder() {
                var next = new Date(Date.now() + 60 * 60 * 1000);
                next.setMinutes(0);
                next.setSeconds(0);
                next.setMilliseconds(0);
                return next;
            }

            function toggleReminder() {
                saverConfirm.reminderEnabled = !saverConfirm.reminderEnabled;
                if (saverConfirm.reminderEnabled
                    && saverConfirm.reminderAt <= new Date()) {
                    saverConfirm.reminderAt = saverConfirm.defaultReminder();
                }
            }

            function shiftReminderMinutes(minutes) {
                saverConfirm.reminderAt =
                    new Date(saverConfirm.reminderAt.getTime() + minutes * 60 * 1000);
            }

            function startOfDay(date) {
                return new Date(date.getFullYear(), date.getMonth(), date.getDate());
            }

            function daysFromToday(days) {
                var date = new Date();
                date.setDate(date.getDate() + days);
                return date;
            }

            function setReminderDate(date) {
                saverConfirm.reminderAt =
                    new Date(date.getFullYear(), date.getMonth(), date.getDate(),
                             saverConfirm.reminderAt.getHours(),
                             saverConfirm.reminderAt.getMinutes(), 0, 0);
            }

            function setReminderTime(hours, minutes) {
                var next = new Date(saverConfirm.reminderAt.getTime());
                next.setHours(hours, minutes, 0, 0);
                saverConfirm.reminderAt = next;
            }

            function dateIsDaysAway(days) {
                return saverConfirm.startOfDay(saverConfirm.reminderAt).getTime()
                    === saverConfirm.startOfDay(saverConfirm.daysFromToday(days)).getTime();
            }

            function timeIs(hours, minutes) {
                return saverConfirm.reminderAt.getHours() === hours
                    && saverConfirm.reminderAt.getMinutes() === minutes;
            }

            function applyRepeatMode(mode) {
                saverConfirm.repeatMode = mode;
                if (mode === "none") {
                    saverConfirm.reminderWeekdays = [];
                } else if (mode === "daily") {
                    saverConfirm.reminderWeekdays = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7];
                } else if (mode === "weekly") {
                    saverConfirm.reminderWeekdays = [saverConfirm.reminderAt.getDay() + 1];
                }
            }

            function repeatModeFor(weekdays) {
                if (!weekdays || weekdays.length === 0) return "none";
                if (weekdays.length === 7) return "daily";
                if (weekdays.length === 1) return "weekly";
                return "custom";
            }

            function calendarCells() {
                var year = saverConfirm.calendarMonth.getFullYear();
                var month = saverConfirm.calendarMonth.getMonth();
                var lead = (new Date(year, month, 1).getDay() + 6) % 7;
                var count = new Date(year, month + 1, 0).getDate();
                var cells = [];
                for (var i = 0; i < lead; i++) cells.push(0);
                for (var day = 1; day <= count; day++) cells.push(day);
                while (cells.length % 7 !== 0) cells.push(0);
                return cells;
            }

            function shiftCalendarMonth(months) {
                saverConfirm.calendarMonth =
                    new Date(saverConfirm.calendarMonth.getFullYear(),
                             saverConfirm.calendarMonth.getMonth() + months, 1);
            }

            function calendarDaySelected(day) {
                return day > 0
                    && saverConfirm.reminderAt.getDate() === day
                    && saverConfirm.reminderAt.getMonth()
                       === saverConfirm.calendarMonth.getMonth()
                    && saverConfirm.reminderAt.getFullYear()
                       === saverConfirm.calendarMonth.getFullYear();
            }

            function openCalendar() {
                saverConfirm.calendarMonth =
                    new Date(saverConfirm.reminderAt.getFullYear(),
                             saverConfirm.reminderAt.getMonth(), 1);
                saverConfirm.picking = "date";
            }

            function pickCalendarDay(day) {
                if (day <= 0) return;
                saverConfirm.setReminderDate(
                    new Date(saverConfirm.calendarMonth.getFullYear(),
                             saverConfirm.calendarMonth.getMonth(), day));
                saverConfirm.picking = "reminder";
            }

            function toggleReminderWeekday(weekday) {
                var next = saverConfirm.reminderWeekdays.slice(0);
                var index = next.indexOf(weekday);
                if (index >= 0) {
                    next.splice(index, 1);
                } else {
                    next.push(weekday);
                }
                next.sort(function (a, b) { return a - b; });
                saverConfirm.reminderWeekdays = next;
            }

            function reminderPayload() {
                return {
                    scheduledAt: saverConfirm.reminderAt.toISOString(),
                    repeatWeekdays: saverConfirm.reminderWeekdays,
                    timeZone: saverConfirm.timeZone,
                    playsSound: saverConfirm.reminderPlaysSound,
                    isImportant: saverConfirm.reminderIsImportant,
                };
            }

            function reminderSummary() {
                if (!saverConfirm.reminderEnabled) {
                    return "Reminder: Off";
                }
                var when = Qt.formatDate(saverConfirm.reminderAt, "ddd d MMM")
                    + ", " + Qt.formatTime(saverConfirm.reminderAt, "hh:mm");
                if (saverConfirm.reminderWeekdays.length > 0) {
                    when += ", repeats";
                }
                return "Reminder: " + when;
            }

            function openFor(initialText, spaceList, activeSpaceId,
                             defaultSpaceId, defaultListId, timeZone) {
                saverConfirm.text = initialText;
                saverConfirm.spaces = spaceList;
                saverConfirm.picking = "";

                saverConfirm.timeZone = timeZone || "UTC";
                saverConfirm.reminderEnabled = false;
                saverConfirm.reminderAt = saverConfirm.defaultReminder();
                saverConfirm.reminderWeekdays = [];
                saverConfirm.reminderPlaysSound = true;
                saverConfirm.reminderIsImportant = false;
                saverConfirm.repeatMode = "none";
                saverConfirm.reminderNudging = false;

                var target = saverSend.resolveTarget(spaceList, activeSpaceId,
                                                     defaultSpaceId, defaultListId);
                saverConfirm.spaceId = target.spaceId;
                saverConfirm.spaceName = target.spaceName;
                saverConfirm.listId = target.listId;
                saverConfirm.listName = target.listName;

                confirmTextEdit.text = initialText;
                saverConfirm.visible = true;
            }

            function selectSpace(id, name) {
                saverConfirm.spaceId = id;
                saverConfirm.spaceName = name;
                saverConfirm.listId = "";
                saverConfirm.listName = "No list";
                saverConfirm.picking = "";
            }

            function selectList(id, name) {
                saverConfirm.listId = id;
                saverConfirm.listName = name;
                saverConfirm.picking = "";
            }

            function cancel() {
                saverConfirm.visible = false;
                saverToast.show("Discarded", false);
            }

            function submit() {
                var finalText = confirmTextEdit.text.trim();
                if (finalText.length === 0) {
                    return;
                }
                saverConfirm.visible = false;
                saverToast.show("Saving " + saverToast.shorten(finalText) + "...", true);
                saverSend.postTodo(finalText, saverConfirm.spaceId, saverConfirm.listId,
                                   saverConfirm.reminderEnabled
                                       ? saverConfirm.reminderPayload() : null);
            }

            Column {
                anchors.left: parent.left
                anchors.right: parent.right
                anchors.top: parent.top
                anchors.margins: 32
                spacing: 20
                visible: saverConfirm.picking.length === 0

                Text {
                    text: "Save to Saver"
                    font.pixelSize: 34
                    font.bold: true
                    color: "black"
                }

                Rectangle {
                    width: parent.width
                    height: 180
                    color: "white"
                    border.color: "black"
                    border.width: 2
                    radius: 6

                    Flickable {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        anchors.margins: 14
                        clip: true
                        contentWidth: width
                        contentHeight: confirmTextEdit.implicitHeight

                        TextEdit {
                            id: confirmTextEdit
                            width: parent.width
                            font.pixelSize: 28
                            color: "black"
                            wrapMode: TextEdit.Wrap
                        }
                    }
                }

                Row {
                    width: parent.width
                    spacing: 16

                    Rectangle {
                        width: (parent.width - 16) / 2
                        height: 64
                        color: "white"
                        border.color: "black"
                        border.width: 2
                        radius: 6

                        Text {
                            anchors.fill: parent
                            anchors.margins: 12
                            text: "Space: " + saverConfirm.spaceName
                            font.pixelSize: 24
                            color: "black"
                            elide: Text.ElideRight
                            verticalAlignment: Text.AlignVCenter
                        }

                        MouseArea {
                            anchors.fill: parent
                            onClicked: saverConfirm.picking = "space"
                        }
                    }

                    Rectangle {
                        width: (parent.width - 16) / 2
                        height: 64
                        color: "white"
                        border.color: "black"
                        border.width: 2
                        radius: 6
                        opacity: saverConfirm.spaceId.length > 0 ? 1.0 : 0.4

                        Text {
                            anchors.fill: parent
                            anchors.margins: 12
                            text: "List: " + saverConfirm.listName
                            font.pixelSize: 24
                            color: "black"
                            elide: Text.ElideRight
                            verticalAlignment: Text.AlignVCenter
                        }

                        MouseArea {
                            anchors.fill: parent
                            enabled: saverConfirm.spaceId.length > 0
                            onClicked: saverConfirm.picking = "list"
                        }
                    }
                }

                Rectangle {
                    width: parent.width
                    height: 64
                    color: "white"
                    border.color: "black"
                    border.width: saverConfirm.reminderEnabled ? 3 : 2
                    radius: 6

                    Text {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        anchors.margins: 12
                        text: saverConfirm.reminderSummary()
                        font.pixelSize: 24
                        color: "black"
                        elide: Text.ElideRight
                        verticalAlignment: Text.AlignVCenter
                    }

                    MouseArea {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        onClicked: saverConfirm.picking = "reminder"
                    }
                }

                Row {
                    width: parent.width
                    spacing: 16
                    height: 76

                    Rectangle {
                        width: (parent.width - 16) / 2
                        height: parent.height
                        color: "white"
                        border.color: "black"
                        border.width: 2
                        radius: 8

                        Text {
                            anchors.centerIn: parent
                            text: "Cancel"
                            font.pixelSize: 28
                            color: "black"
                        }

                        MouseArea {
                            anchors.fill: parent
                            onClicked: saverConfirm.cancel()
                        }
                    }

                    Rectangle {
                        width: (parent.width - 16) / 2
                        height: parent.height
                        color: "white"
                        border.color: "black"
                        border.width: 3
                        radius: 8
                        opacity: confirmTextEdit.text.trim().length > 0 ? 1.0 : 0.35

                        Text {
                            anchors.centerIn: parent
                            text: "Save"
                            font.pixelSize: 28
                            font.bold: true
                            color: "black"
                        }

                        MouseArea {
                            anchors.fill: parent
                            enabled: confirmTextEdit.text.trim().length > 0
                            onClicked: saverConfirm.submit()
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            Column {
                anchors.fill: parent
                anchors.margins: 24
                spacing: 16
                visible: saverConfirm.picking === "space"
                         || saverConfirm.picking === "list"

                Text {
                    text: saverConfirm.picking === "space" ? "Choose a space" : "Choose a list"
                    font.pixelSize: 30
                    font.bold: true
                    color: "black"
                }

                ListView {
                    id: pickerList
                    width: parent.width
                    height: parent.height - 130
                    clip: true
                    model: {
                        if (saverConfirm.picking === "space") {
                            return saverConfirm.spaces;
                        }
                        if (saverConfirm.picking === "list") {
                            var options = [{ id: "", title: "No list" }];
                            return options.concat(saverConfirm.currentLists());
                        }
                        return [];
                    }

                    delegate: Rectangle {
                        width: pickerList.width
                        height: 72
                        color: "white"

                        Text {
                            anchors.left: parent.left
                            anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                            anchors.leftMargin: 8
                            text: saverConfirm.picking === "space" ? modelData.name : modelData.title
                            font.pixelSize: 26
                            color: "black"
                        }

                        Rectangle {
                            anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
                            width: parent.width
                            height: 1
                            color: "#d0d0d0"
                        }

                        MouseArea {
                            anchors.fill: parent
                            onClicked: {
                                if (saverConfirm.picking === "space") {
                                    saverConfirm.selectSpace(modelData.id, modelData.name);
                                } else {
                                    saverConfirm.selectList(modelData.id, modelData.title);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                Rectangle {
                    width: parent.width
                    height: 76
                    color: "white"
                    border.color: "black"
                    border.width: 2
                    radius: 8

                    Text {
                        anchors.centerIn: parent
                        text: "Back"
                        font.pixelSize: 28
                        color: "black"
                    }

                    MouseArea {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        onClicked: saverConfirm.picking = ""
                    }
                }
            }

            Column {
                id: saverReminderPage

                anchors.fill: parent
                anchors.margins: 24
                spacing: 16
                visible: saverConfirm.picking === "reminder"

                Row {
                    width: parent.width
                    height: 68
                    spacing: 16

                    Column {
                        anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                        width: parent.width - 176
                        spacing: 4

                        Text {
                            text: "Reminder on your phone"
                            font.pixelSize: 30
                            font.bold: true
                            color: "black"
                        }

                        Text {
                            width: parent.width
                            text: "Saver sends this to your signed-in phone."
                            font.pixelSize: 22
                            color: "black"
                            opacity: 0.6
                            elide: Text.ElideRight
                        }
                    }

                    Rectangle {
                        width: 160
                        height: 68
                        color: saverConfirm.reminderEnabled ? "black" : "white"
                        border.color: "black"
                        border.width: 2
                        radius: 6
                        antialiasing: false

                        Text {
                            anchors.centerIn: parent
                            text: saverConfirm.reminderEnabled ? "On" : "Off"
                            font.pixelSize: 28
                            color: saverConfirm.reminderEnabled ? "white" : "black"
                        }

                        MouseArea {
                            anchors.fill: parent
                            onClicked: saverConfirm.toggleReminder()
                        }
                    }
                }

                Text {
                    width: parent.width
                    text: "Turn this on to pick a date and time."
                    font.pixelSize: 24
                    color: "black"
                    opacity: 0.6
                    visible: !saverConfirm.reminderEnabled
                    elide: Text.ElideRight
                }

                Row {
                    width: parent.width
                    height: 36
                    visible: saverConfirm.reminderEnabled

                    Text {
                        width: 120
                        height: 36
                        text: "DATE"
                        font.pixelSize: 24
                        color: "black"
                        verticalAlignment: Text.AlignVCenter
                    }

                    Text {
                        width: saverReminderPage.width - 120
                        height: 36
                        text: Qt.formatDate(saverConfirm.reminderAt, "ddd d MMM yyyy")
                        font.pixelSize: 27
                        font.bold: true
                        color: "black"
                        elide: Text.ElideRight
                        horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignRight
                        verticalAlignment: Text.AlignVCenter
                    }
                }

                Row {
                    width: parent.width
                    height: 72
                    spacing: 12
                    visible: saverConfirm.reminderEnabled

                    Repeater {
                        model: [
                            { label: "Today", days: 0 },
                            { label: "Tomorrow", days: 1 },
                            { label: "In 1 week", days: 7 },
                            { label: "Pick date...", days: -1 },
                        ]

                        delegate: Rectangle {
                            property bool selected: modelData.days >= 0
                                                    && saverConfirm.dateIsDaysAway(modelData.days)

                            width: (saverReminderPage.width - 36) / 4
                            height: 72
                            color: "white"
                            border.color: "black"
                            border.width: selected ? 5 : 2
                            radius: 8
                            antialiasing: false

                            Text {
                                anchors.fill: parent
                                anchors.margins: 8
                                text: modelData.label
                                font.pixelSize: 24
                                font.bold: parent.selected
                                color: "black"
                                elide: Text.ElideRight
                                horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
                                verticalAlignment: Text.AlignVCenter
                            }

                            MouseArea {
                                anchors.fill: parent
                                onClicked: {
                                    if (modelData.days < 0) {
                                        saverConfirm.openCalendar();
                                    } else {
                                        saverConfirm.setReminderDate(
                                            saverConfirm.daysFromToday(modelData.days));
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                Row {
                    width: parent.width
                    height: 40
                    visible: saverConfirm.reminderEnabled

                    Text {
                        width: 120
                        height: 40
                        text: "TIME"
                        font.pixelSize: 24
                        color: "black"
                        verticalAlignment: Text.AlignVCenter
                    }

                    Text {
                        width: saverReminderPage.width - 120
                        height: 40
                        text: Qt.formatTime(saverConfirm.reminderAt, "hh:mm")
                        font.pixelSize: 32
                        font.bold: true
                        color: "black"
                        horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignRight
                        verticalAlignment: Text.AlignVCenter
                    }
                }

                Row {
                    width: parent.width
                    height: 72
                    spacing: 12
                    visible: saverConfirm.reminderEnabled

                    Repeater {
                        model: [
                            { label: "Morning", hour: 8, minute: 0 },
                            { label: "12:00", hour: 12, minute: 0 },
                            { label: "18:00", hour: 18, minute: 0 },
                            { label: "Pick time...", hour: -1, minute: 0 },
                        ]

                        delegate: Rectangle {
                            property bool selected: modelData.hour < 0
                                ? saverConfirm.reminderNudging
                                : saverConfirm.timeIs(modelData.hour, modelData.minute)

                            width: (saverReminderPage.width - 36) / 4
                            height: 72
                            color: "white"
                            border.color: "black"
                            border.width: selected ? 5 : 2
                            radius: 8
                            antialiasing: false

                            Text {
                                anchors.fill: parent
                                anchors.margins: 8
                                text: modelData.label
                                font.pixelSize: 24
                                font.bold: parent.selected
                                color: "black"
                                elide: Text.ElideRight
                                horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
                                verticalAlignment: Text.AlignVCenter
                            }

                            MouseArea {
                                anchors.fill: parent
                                onClicked: {
                                    if (modelData.hour < 0) {
                                        saverConfirm.reminderNudging =
                                            !saverConfirm.reminderNudging;
                                    } else {
                                        saverConfirm.setReminderTime(modelData.hour,
                                                                     modelData.minute);
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                Row {
                    width: parent.width
                    height: 72
                    spacing: 12
                    visible: saverConfirm.reminderEnabled && saverConfirm.reminderNudging

                    Repeater {
                        model: [
                            { label: "-1h", minutes: -60 },
                            { label: "-15m", minutes: -15 },
                            { label: "+15m", minutes: 15 },
                            { label: "+1h", minutes: 60 },
                        ]

                        delegate: Rectangle {
                            width: (saverReminderPage.width - 36) / 4
                            height: 72
                            color: "white"
                            border.color: "black"
                            border.width: 2
                            radius: 8
                            antialiasing: false

                            Text {
                                anchors.centerIn: parent
                                text: modelData.label
                                font.pixelSize: 24
                                color: "black"
                            }

                            MouseArea {
                                anchors.fill: parent
                                onClicked: saverConfirm.shiftReminderMinutes(modelData.minutes)
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                Text {
                    text: "REPEAT"
                    font.pixelSize: 24
                    color: "black"
                    visible: saverConfirm.reminderEnabled
                }

                Row {
                    width: parent.width
                    height: 72
                    spacing: 12
                    visible: saverConfirm.reminderEnabled

                    Repeater {
                        model: [
                            { label: "None", mode: "none" },
                            { label: "Daily", mode: "daily" },
                            { label: "Weekly", mode: "weekly" },
                            { label: "Custom...", mode: "custom" },
                        ]

                        delegate: Rectangle {
                            property bool selected: saverConfirm.repeatMode === modelData.mode

                            width: (saverReminderPage.width - 36) / 4
                            height: 72
                            color: "white"
                            border.color: "black"
                            border.width: selected ? 5 : 2
                            radius: 8
                            antialiasing: false

                            Text {
                                anchors.fill: parent
                                anchors.margins: 8
                                text: modelData.label
                                font.pixelSize: 24
                                font.bold: parent.selected
                                color: "black"
                                elide: Text.ElideRight
                                horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
                                verticalAlignment: Text.AlignVCenter
                            }

                            MouseArea {
                                anchors.fill: parent
                                onClicked: saverConfirm.applyRepeatMode(modelData.mode)
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                Row {
                    width: parent.width
                    height: 60
                    spacing: 10
                    visible: saverConfirm.reminderEnabled
                             && (saverConfirm.repeatMode === "weekly"
                                 || saverConfirm.repeatMode === "custom")

                    Repeater {
                        model: ["S", "M", "T", "W", "T", "F", "S"]

                        delegate: Rectangle {
                            width: (saverReminderPage.width - 60) / 7
                            height: 60
                            color: saverConfirm.reminderWeekdays.indexOf(index + 1) >= 0
                                   ? "black" : "white"
                            border.color: "black"
                            border.width: 2
                            radius: 6
                            antialiasing: false

                            Text {
                                anchors.centerIn: parent
                                text: modelData
                                font.pixelSize: 26
                                color: saverConfirm.reminderWeekdays.indexOf(index + 1) >= 0
                                       ? "white" : "black"
                            }

                            MouseArea {
                                anchors.fill: parent
                                onClicked: {
                                    saverConfirm.toggleReminderWeekday(index + 1);
                                    saverConfirm.repeatMode = saverConfirm.repeatModeFor(
                                        saverConfirm.reminderWeekdays);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                Row {
                    width: parent.width
                    height: 60
                    spacing: 16
                    visible: saverConfirm.reminderEnabled

                    Rectangle {
                        width: (saverReminderPage.width - 16) / 2
                        height: 60
                        color: saverConfirm.reminderPlaysSound ? "black" : "white"
                        border.color: "black"
                        border.width: 2
                        radius: 6
                        antialiasing: false

                        Text {
                            anchors.centerIn: parent
                            text: saverConfirm.reminderPlaysSound ? "Sound on" : "Silent"
                            font.pixelSize: 24
                            color: saverConfirm.reminderPlaysSound ? "white" : "black"
                        }

                        MouseArea {
                            anchors.fill: parent
                            onClicked: saverConfirm.reminderPlaysSound =
                                       !saverConfirm.reminderPlaysSound
                        }
                    }

                    Rectangle {
                        width: (saverReminderPage.width - 16) / 2
                        height: 60
                        color: saverConfirm.reminderIsImportant ? "black" : "white"
                        border.color: "black"
                        border.width: 2
                        radius: 6
                        antialiasing: false

                        Text {
                            anchors.centerIn: parent
                            text: "Time-sensitive"
                            font.pixelSize: 24
                            color: saverConfirm.reminderIsImportant ? "white" : "black"
                        }

                        MouseArea {
                            anchors.fill: parent
                            onClicked: saverConfirm.reminderIsImportant =
                                       !saverConfirm.reminderIsImportant
                        }
                    }
                }

                Rectangle {
                    width: parent.width
                    height: 76
                    color: "white"
                    border.color: "black"
                    border.width: 2
                    radius: 8

                    Text {
                        anchors.centerIn: parent
                        text: "Back"
                        font.pixelSize: 28
                        color: "black"
                    }

                    MouseArea {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        onClicked: saverConfirm.picking = ""
                    }
                }
            }

            Column {
                id: saverCalendarPage

                anchors.fill: parent
                anchors.margins: 24
                spacing: 12
                visible: saverConfirm.picking === "date"

                Row {
                    width: parent.width
                    height: 64
                    spacing: 12

                    Rectangle {
                        width: 88
                        height: 64
                        color: "white"
                        border.color: "black"
                        border.width: 2
                        radius: 8

                        Text {
                            anchors.centerIn: parent
                            text: "\u2039"
                            font.pixelSize: 40
                            color: "black"
                        }

                        MouseArea {
                            anchors.fill: parent
                            onClicked: saverConfirm.shiftCalendarMonth(-1)
                        }
                    }

                    Text {
                        width: saverCalendarPage.width - 200
                        height: 64
                        text: Qt.formatDate(saverConfirm.calendarMonth, "MMMM yyyy")
                        font.pixelSize: 30
                        font.bold: true
                        color: "black"
                        horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
                        verticalAlignment: Text.AlignVCenter
                    }

                    Rectangle {
                        width: 88
                        height: 64
                        color: "white"
                        border.color: "black"
                        border.width: 2
                        radius: 8

                        Text {
                            anchors.centerIn: parent
                            text: "\u203a"
                            font.pixelSize: 40
                            color: "black"
                        }

                        MouseArea {
                            anchors.fill: parent
                            onClicked: saverConfirm.shiftCalendarMonth(1)
                        }
                    }
                }

                Row {
                    width: parent.width
                    height: 30
                    spacing: 8

                    Repeater {
                        model: ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"]

                        delegate: Text {
                            width: (saverCalendarPage.width - 48) / 7
                            height: 30
                            text: modelData
                            font.pixelSize: 22
                            color: "black"
                            opacity: 0.6
                            horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
                            verticalAlignment: Text.AlignVCenter
                        }
                    }
                }

                Grid {
                    width: parent.width
                    columns: 7
                    spacing: 8

                    Repeater {
                        model: saverConfirm.calendarCells()

                        delegate: Rectangle {
                            property bool selected: saverConfirm.calendarDaySelected(modelData)

                            width: (saverCalendarPage.width - 48) / 7
                            height: 72
                            color: "white"
                            border.color: modelData > 0 ? "black" : "transparent"
                            border.width: selected ? 5 : 2
                            radius: 8
                            antialiasing: false

                            Text {
                                anchors.centerIn: parent
                                text: modelData > 0 ? modelData : ""
                                font.pixelSize: 26
                                font.bold: parent.selected
                                color: "black"
                            }

                            MouseArea {
                                anchors.fill: parent
                                enabled: modelData > 0
                                onClicked: saverConfirm.pickCalendarDay(modelData)
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                Rectangle {
                    width: parent.width
                    height: 72
                    color: "white"
                    border.color: "black"
                    border.width: 2
                    radius: 8

                    Text {
                        anchors.centerIn: parent
                        text: "Back"
                        font.pixelSize: 28
                        color: "black"
                    }

                    MouseArea {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        onClicked: saverConfirm.picking = "reminder"
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/HwcSelection.qml
    TRAVERSE Item > HwcNotificationBar#handwritingBar
        REPLACE onFinishedChanged WITH {
        onFinishedChanged: {
            if (!finished) {
                return;
            }
            if (!root.visible) {
                return;
            }
            Clipboard.text = recognitionJob.formattedTextToClipboardText();
            if (Clipboard.hasText) {
                conversionFinished();
            }
        }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
